standard_prerequisites: The calculus G3c, its atomic axioms, and the notion of the height of a proof.
core_obligations: Prove that both weakening rules are height-preserving admissible in G3c by induction on the proof height: a proof of the sequent Gamma, Delta of height n yields a proof with the added formula A in the respective context, of height exactly n.
Height-zero case: atomic axioms stay axioms after weakening since the added formula does not disturb the shared atomic sentence.

Positive case: the weakening formula is never principal in the last inference, so the inductive hypothesis applies to the immediate subproofs and the last rule is re-applied, with the max-formula height bookkeeping, exemplified in full for right-and.
proof_roadmap: Set the induction on height with the exact-height conclusion.
Dispatch the axiom case by atomicity.

Dispatch the inductive case generically: the added formula sits in the context, the inductive hypothesis weakens the subproofs, and the last rule re-applies; the right-and instance is worked out with both subproofs and the height equality.
difficulty_reason: A two-case induction with an explicit derivation for the pattern instance; the substantive step is observing the weakened formula is never principal, so the same rule re-applies and the height is preserved exactly.
